orders.instruction: Strict bed rest; no out-of-bed activity.
Supervised hallway ambulation with physical therapy.
orders.conditions: Requires the patient to get out of bed during the session.

applicable_rules.description: Activity orders must be feasible within the same time interval
applicable_rules.constraint: A strict bed-rest order prohibiting out-of-bed activity cannot be active at the same time as an order requiring out-of-bed ambulation.

consistency_findings.rationale: Order 1 requires strict bed rest through 12:00, while order 2 requires hallway ambulation at 10:00. The ambulation falls within the bed-rest interval, so both instructions cannot be carried out as written.
consistency_findings.suggested_resolution: Ask the responsible clinician to clarify the intended activity level and revise either the bed-rest interval or the ambulation schedule.
